items.title: Pack installation is now available
items.summary: The pack registry exposes official namespaces, manifests, lockfiles, and a companion CLI with Control Plane command spelling.

items.title: Standalone Web Kit distribution
items.summary: Versioned browser assets, registry snapshots, install docs, compatibility notes, checksums, and a Pages showcase are available.

items.title: Control Plane Pages surface launched
items.summary: The public Control Plane documents governed resources, modding, crates, packs, Web Kit distribution, and the future pack network.

items.title: Canonical theme registry now has 312 themes
items.summary: The shared registry continues to drive the Theme Studio, Control Plane, Web Kit snapshot, and Cybercore public surfaces.

items.title: Reduced-motion policy is carried through every surface
items.summary: Web Kit effects provide static and reduced variants, while pack manifests record compatibility, provenance, and accessibility metadata.

items.title: Pack archives and checksum enforcement
items.summary: The next registry milestone migrates real resource payloads into release archives with enforced SHA-256 verification and dependency resolution.
